decisions.decision: The committee agreed that the Finance Committee report on Town Finances, which has been in the Town Meeting Warrant, should remain there (suggested by Mark; no formal vote recorded).
decisions.quote: it should remain there. the committee agreed.

decisions.decision: The committee will receive a presentation on the funding of the pavement management plan at a future date.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Mosquito Control Project notified the Town that the Town's assessment is $68,307, in line with past assessments.
budget_items.quote: notified the town that our assessment is $68,307. it is in line with our assessment in the past.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A projected $600,000 in the capital budget, net of debt service for three financed items, is not enough to fund all capital requests, so some will not be granted; the CPC will rank requests next week.
budget_items.quote: there is a projected $600,000 in the capital budget net of the debt service costs for the three items the town purchased through financing.

budget_items.topic: Junior-Senior High School building project change order and contingency
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Building Committee approved change order #7 totaling $31,540, bringing total expenditures from contingency funds to $208,000.
budget_items.quote: they approved change order #7 which totaled $31,540. that brings total expenditures from contingency funds to $208,000.

budget_items.topic: Pending change orders, school building project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The largest pending change order is $185,000 for a maintenance garage; the others are still under discussion.
budget_items.quote: the largest item on the pending change orders is $185,000 for a maintenance garage.

budget_items.topic: Debt service and bond rating outlook
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The S&P rating update is due shortly and the outlook could change to negative because of debt service from the Junior-Senior High School construction project.
budget_items.quote: because of the amount of debt service the town has incurred from the junior-senior high school construction project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW will report at the next meeting on snow and ice removal costs incurred to date and whether it can spend at least to budget; no dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: no report-will report at our next meeting about snow and ice removal costs incurred to date and prospects of managing to spend at least to the budget.

budget_items.topic: Library state grants and FY17 appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Differences in the appropriation level needed to satisfy grant requirements for two state library grants were discussed; no dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: terri noted differences in the appropriation level necessary to satisfy the grant requirements and get the two state library grants.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commission and School Committee are setting up a user-fee funding mechanism for the Turf Field and Track; renovating the track is more critical and costlier than the field. No dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: renovating the track is more critical than renovating the field; there is more risk of failure of the foundation underlying the track, with a much higher cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sue Doherty presented her budget, which is right in line with the Town Manager's request; no dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: sue doherty presented her budget which is right in line with the town manager's request.
